reviews.comment: Crisp, buttery layers. Still warm the next morning.
Fresh lemon filling, not too sweet. The crust could be a little crispier.
The rosemary aroma is just right, and the top is soft with well-balanced salt.
Open crumb, a pleasant sourdough tang, and still fresh three days later.
Strong hojicha flavor, soft in the middle and crisp at the edges.
Nicely charred top and a creamy center. The portion is a bit big for one person.
The rye flavor is strong but not bitter. Good for a cheese sandwich.
Tasty, but the caramel is too thick and covers the lemon flavor.
Light as a cloud, and still soft two days later. This is our family's favorite bread.
Thick, crisp crust, and the tang pairs well with jam.
The matcha is not too bitter and the texture is melty. Worth buying again.
Good, though it arrived a little cold. The lamination quality still shows.
Unique taste, but I think the hojicha aroma could be stronger.
Neatly sliced and very soft. Good for toasting.
The best cake I bought this month. The packaging was neat too.
Perfect for breakfast. The inside is airy like a honeycomb.
The cookie crust is thin and crisp, but the bread part is a bit dry.
Tasty and soft, I just wish it were a little bigger.
Strong brown butter aroma and lots of chocolate. My kid asked for seconds.
The bottom is burnt and the chocolate has hardened. Very disappointed with today's quality.
Too salty and a bit tough. Maybe just bad luck, but a shame for the price.
Nice pores and you can taste the olive oil. A little more rosemary would be better.
Pretty good, but less crisp at the edges than I expected.
An honest, filling bread. I like the fermentation aroma.
The curry filling was too runny and the bread went cold quickly. I may try another variant.
A solid rye bread. Good for sandwiches and stays fresh in the fridge.
